processing: Lanczos downsample from published 6000x3000 optical panorama; RGB JPEG quality 95 without chroma subsampling. No upscaling, generative edits, invented objects or extra sharpening. Brightness and orientation may be adjusted in the app. The unreleased 800-million-pixel original is not used.
limits: Photographic multi-month all-sky composite published 2009; not a current local sky, not an external photograph of the Galaxy. Earth/Moon placement, relative sizes and sky orientation are composed.
